reviews.text: The staff is always super friendly, and Dr. Sondhi truly takes his time and genuinely cares about my pup, which means everything to me!! The hospital is also always very clean, tidy, and up to date. I really appreciate that they’re now open on Sundays and offer so many different payment options for patients. You can tell that helping animals and making sure they receive the care they need is truly the priority here, rather than making it feel like just a transaction. So grateful to have found a vet I trust with my girl! 🤍

Dr. Sondhi is simply THE BEST! IF I CAN RATE THIS 10 STARS  I WOULD!!!

I cannot say enough amazing things about Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital and Dr. Sondhi. Of all the veterinarians I have taken my fur babies to over the years, Dr. Sondhi is by far the BEST.

He is compassionate, extremely knowledgeable, reasonable, honest, and genuinely kind-hearted. Finding a veterinarian, you can completely trust is not easy especially when, as pet owners, we have to rely on their knowledge and recommendations to make the best decisions for our babies.

I have three giant fur babies, and I will NEVER take them anywhere else. If that means waiting until Dr. Sondhi is available, WE WAIT! At least I know my babies are in good hands, receiving the care they actually need, and that I am not going to be unnecessarily overcharged.

Before finding Dr. Sondhi, I used to take my dogs to Del Norte Animal Hospital. It seemed like almost every visit was hundreds of dollars. An ear infection that kept coming back could easily cost around $350, and other visits sometimes ended up around $500. Even medications that I have received through Dr. Sondhi for a very reasonable price seemed to cost significantly more there. The difference has been eye-opening.

I don't write positive reviews simply because I "like" a place. My expectations are high when it comes to professionalism, cleanliness, knowledge, empathy, compassion, and most importantly, honesty and fair pricing. Pet owners should be able to trust that recommendations are being made because their pet truly needs them, not because it increases the bill.

Dr. Sondhi has earned our trust completely. He treats our fur babies with compassion and treats us with respect. That peace of mind is priceless.

Dr. Sondhi, you are AWESOME. Amazing. One of a kind. We absolutely love and appreciate you! ❤️🐾

If you're looking for an honest, knowledgeable, compassionate veterinarian who truly cares about your pets, I cannot recommend Dr. Sondhi and Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital enough. 10/10! 🐶❤️
Dr Erin Rosa was great. Gretta has a skin and flea problem and I feel completely confident we will have this under control in no time. Staff is super friendly, clean facility. Highly recommend.

Dr Sandhi was great he took his time with our Shelby and we are so grateful for him and his team for taking their time and making sure they diagnosed our dog properly. I would recommend Rancho Bernardo pet hospital

Dr. Sondi and his team took incredible care of our Belgian Malinois when he needed urgent surgery. His staff, especially Stacie, went above and beyond to accommodate us right away, working him in on last minute notice when we needed help fast. Dr. Sondi did a fantastic job on the surgery itself, and his follow-up care was thorough and attentive every step of the way. Highly recommend this practice to anyone needing reliable, compassionate veterinary care, especially in an urgent situation.

After trying this office a few months ago, I knew we had found our new veterinarian. Unfortunately, just a few weeks later, our dog was severely injured in a dog attack and needed ongoing care. Throughout one of the most stressful experiences we’ve ever had, the entire team has been absolutely incredible.

Everyone is genuinely kind, compassionate, and patient. They never make you feel rushed and always take the time to thoroughly explain everything, answer every question, and make sure you feel comfortable with the treatment plan.

What has impressed us the most is their honesty and fairness. Unlike some clinics that seem to charge for every little thing, this team has been incredibly reasonable. When our dog needed frequent wound checks and follow-up visits, they focused on what was best for him rather than finding ways to add unnecessary charges. That level of integrity is rare and meant so much to us during an already difficult time.

Their compassion, expertise, and exceptional care helped both our dog and our family through a very challenging five weeks. We are beyond grateful for everything they’ve done and cannot recommend them highly enough. If you’re looking for a veterinary office that truly cares about both your pet and your family, this is the place.

Had to put my dog down here and was scammed over the bill during a very difficult time. Fine staff who did show care for our pet, but DO NOT TRUST their pricing until it is written on paper or they will switch up on you when the time comes.

Be very wary about getting any procedures done here or of all things, spending your dog's last day here. Doctor was ok but didn't hold her well when she inserted the sedative causing her to walk off the bed and fall on the hard floor. Being thrown the mobile payment machine right before our dog is put down felt so out of touch as if they were going to say right after paying "its just going to ask you a quick question" (implying a tip request).

They had several chances to do the right thing and invoice us the price they quoted but chose to double down on their mistake. Anyways good luck to customers who go here, get things in writing. Don't fall for their traps!

I would have been ready to give a 5-star until how they handled a billing issue when we had to put our dog down. Never having done this before, I actually had three different calls with the front desk. I asked what the process was, how to schedule, how much it would cost, etc. It was our family dog of 15.5+ years. One of the hardest things I have ever had to do. Anyways, in those calls I was told the cost. On I believe the 3rd called I was actually told upon asking the cost again, "oh I see you were told $272, so your cost will be that same amount of $272." Her words, not mine.

The day of, my family was a bit frantic and distraught, as you can imagine. We were actually a few minutes late bc our sweet girl had an accident in the car so was a complete mess. My daughter and I checked her in while my husband and sons cleaned her outside. I actually thought they would have ask us to take care of the bill at that time while we were waiting for the room to be ready. We were taken to a room with blankets etc. Again, all of us were overwhelmed by sadness. Lots of tears. I saw our dog was still really messy and I ofc didn't want her to be in that state. So I left the room to get some wet paper towels to clean her up. When I came back, I saw that the staff had brought in a portable payment device & paperwork. They had clearly did the bill right then and there, not sure why it needed to be in the room. I was going to ask my husband what the bill was as I was the one who had been communicating with the staff. But I did not. It just wasn't the time and I wanted to focus on the last minutes with our dog and focus on our kids. Not to mention I was told the same amount 3 times, so why would it be different? The actual appointment went well. The staff was nice. She was comfortable. The vet was ok but I will add that she let her walk around right after she gave her the first dose that makes her sleepy so she fell. Ugh. But besides that, she was comfortable taking her last breath.

The next day I asked my husband what the bill amount was. I was shocked to hear it was $82 more than what I was told 3 times. So I called the hospital and explained all this to them. I even agreed with the manager that yes, my husband signed the invoice agreement you gave him. Since she kept saying. "My hands are tied because your husband signed the paper." I also acknowledge that at the time, you did not know that my husband had no communication with you all so didn't know anything about the billing part. But now you know! Now you know that what I was told 3 times, and you are refusing a credit because of an arbitrary paper that means nothing? The fact remains you had no justification for charging me more than what I was told. The manager said she will talk to the owner and her staff. I provided her with a screen shot of the date/time I called so she could narrow down who I spoke to.

She called back saying the entire staff denies giving me any cost amount over the phone, that nothing was written down anywhere, and since my husband signed the paper, she cannot give a credit. I told her that they used an extremely vulnerable moment in the room, to give us a paper to sign and a device to tap.  Poor taste- like we are paying a restaurant bill. And now you are saying that I made this up. Her hands were not tied by a piece of paper that means nothing. Her staff probably denied they told me a cost because they didn't want to lose their jobs. And no one wrote down what they told me, yet each gave the exact number as the one before and one even said "I see what you were told..."  hmmm

Pls note, It's not about the $82. It's about how to stand by what you tell your clients. And doing the right thing when you made a mistake during a vulnerable time. And thinking about protocols in place and making them better, like not making someone sign a paper while under distress. Be better & treat your clients better.

I was aware of the factors that impact the cost & chose the options on my initial call and yet there was a surprise in the final cost. It’s called bait and switch.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We know that pet care is an investment, and we always strive to provide high-quality veterinary medicine at fair, honest, and reasonable prices. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

Best regards,
The Team at Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital

Hi Shirin,

Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pets again soon.

Regards,
Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital
New facilities with clean and spacious exam rooms.
Great place specially that I could book a last min session urgently and theybwere very supportive

Made an appt to have both cats have there nails trimmed. I waited over 90 minutes, past my appt
. I talked to Megan(office mgr). She immediately checked and got back that it would be soon.  Megan said they were busy and have been short handed for several months.  I have been with you for 16 years, love you and recommend you. I feel your customer service is falling.  If I would have been a walkin, then I would expect a long wait, but I had an appt, and you knew I was coming in.  I have been there where I walk into the cat entrance,with an appt., and will wait, and finally go to the dog checkin to let you know I'm here.   Thank you for listening. Kim.

5/5 stars! I had a great experience at Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital with my foster dog, Jasmine. Dr. Rose and her assistant Mariana were incredibly kind, patient, and professional—especially since Jasmine can be unpredictable.

They focused on getting to the root of her symptoms without pushing unnecessary tests, were transparent about pricing, and always got my approval before moving forward. I also really appreciated the follow-up after our visit and their guidance on preparing Jasmine to fly to her forever home.

Highly recommend for compassionate, thorough care!

It’s been well over a year since my dog passed and I went here but I still wanted to share what a wonderful experience I had with this team. Everyone there was so kind and helpful. Dr. Rose was absolutely phenomenal when my dog was aging and starting to have some serious issues that were not easy to diagnose. She helped keep diagnostic tests and treatment as affordable as she could every step of the way. I can’t imagine any other vet being there for us like she was. I’ve recommended them to multiple friends since then, all were equally pleased with the level of care.
Love this place, quality doctors, friendly staff ❤️ thank you guys for your service
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your business and hope to see you again soon at Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital.
Would leave 0 stars if I could!!
They take such good care of our fur babies and go over all the options available for our 2 dogs. The staff is friendly and it is not too hard to get an appointment.
Very professional, clean office and great overall experience.
I was there to pick up a prescription for my dog. The lady at the front desk too care of me and 2 other clients really smoothly! Thanks!
Thank you for the wonderful 5-star rating! We’re grateful for clients like you who allow us to do what we love every day. If you ever need anything for your pet, we’re always here to help.

Dont let the high scored reviews fool you. They must pay people for them. I brought my new kitten here for diagnosis of possible ringworm and for a first time exam. During the exam I was told of 2 testing methods and given prices for both. When later up at the front to pay balance the price changed and was 3 times more than I was quoted. I went ahead and paid for the testing anyways as I love my fur baby. I was told the testing would be 2 weeks-14 days. When I called after 2 weeks(no one ever called me) I was told that the testing actually takes 28 days... Here it is 3 weeks later, I called to see if the results were available (again, no one has bothered to call me). They still dont have them and are going to follow up with me later.
This place is a lame! Very unprofessional and I would NOT recommend them!! We love less than a mile away from them and this woukd have been ideal for our new Family Vet offers multiple pets. But heck no! I will find somewhere that offers much better service and  is alot more professional and keeps their word. What a poor excuse of a Pet hospital!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital! We’ve been bringing our kitty here since January 2022, and recently started bringing in our new kitten as well. Between wellness exams, medications, and a few recent health concerns, the entire team has gone above and beyond for both of our cats.

The veterinarians and technicians are incredibly thorough, compassionate, and proactive — they’ve kept in touch with calls and texts to check on our kitties’ progress and ensure all our questions are answered. Even the front desk staff is consistently kind, helpful, and professional.

We live about 30 minutes away, but we’ve never once considered switching to a veterinarian closer to home. The level of care, communication, and genuine love they show for our pets sets the bar impossibly high. Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital has truly earned our trust and gratitude — we’re so thankful for their exceptional team! ♥️🐾

Great price, excellent staff! I knew I had to get my dog spayed. But taking my happy healthy baby (4y/o chiwawa “Sandy”) in to get cut up…? was something I wasn’t sure about… I had already been to two other vets before backing out. But these guys were recommended by an emergency hospital I know and trust.
#1 price was less than I had budgeted.
#2 the genuine love and care from the staff toward my dog.
#3 they fallowed up and overall impressed me!

Kaylee loves going to RBPH! ❤️👍
Nice humans, great care.
Dr. Rose was amazing!  I have a shy rescue dog and she knew exactly how to interact with him and made him feel comfortable right away.

Both my dogs are clients of Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital. Dr. Sondhi, Dr. Rose and Dr. H are very knowledgeable and are amazing. My little pitbull Luca had a terrible skin issue and the Dr’s were able to treat him and get him all healthy again. The staff are so helpful and they treat my dogs so well. Even Junior who doesn’t like anyone has now made friends with the staff. I’m so grateful to have found this Veterinary office. Their new office is so nice.

This clinic is staffed full of really awesome people who are easy to communicate with and make you feel like your pet is in good hands. They are quick on the phone and competent. The doctors are all very kind and enthusiastic. Not dismissive at all. The clinic itself is clean and updated with nice lighting and good seating arrangements in the offices. They have fulfilled our needs and been very fair in pricing and everything else. 10/10 experience and will continue to come here for any concerns with my pet.
RBPH doctors and staff are the best! They care about your pets and they make you feel like they are part of your family and they are reasonable with their pricing.
Every vet and tech and front office staff are so ON IT. Empathetic and efficient and capable. I couldn't imagine taking my pets anywhere else and I hope they stay in the area indefinitely.

I want to thank the team at this vet hospital. We had to bring our little girl in for emergencies 2 days apart. They didn't hesitate to take her back and give her the help she needed. They then helped us as we had to say goodbye. This is not our normal vet, but with the care they provided it felt like they had been seeing our baby for years. Thank you to such an amazing team. We are forever grateful for your kindness during one of the hardest times in our life.

Thank you so much for your kind words!

We're thrilled to hear that you had such a positive experience with us. We always strive to provide exceptional service and quality to every customer. Your feedback inspires our team to keep working hard and delivering top-notch products every single day.

Best regards,
Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital

When it comes to our pets, we all want to find a clinic that truly has a heart. Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital is exactly that kind of place. The entire staff — from the front desk to the veterinarians — are people with huge hearts and a deep love for animals. Every time I bring my pet in with a concern, I feel like I’m with family.

I had an incredible experience that I’ll never forget. My pet started feeling unwell over a long holiday weekend. I knew the clinic was closed, but I called to make an appointment anyway. To my surprise, the doctor actually picked up the phone. For me, that’s the ultimate sign of dedication — to their profession, to the animals they care for, and to the clients who trust them.

Thank you for being there and for everything you do. Your work truly makes a difference.

The vets and staff take excellent care of my pets. They both have health problems and they’ve given me good advice and therapies. The waiting room has happy pets in it. The wait time is negligible. I need help getting my pets in and out of the car and they are glad to help. My dog and cat are healthier now than when we first got here.

I recently moved to San Diego and needed to find a new vet for my fur baby. This veterinary clinic was referred to me by an animal pharmaceutical rep. We saw Dr. Rose and she was so good at her job. She has the best personality to be a vet and you can tell she loves animals. She was very attentive, listened to all my needs, gave recommendations and educated me in many areas involving the new environment we now live in. She was very kind and loving to my dog and was genuinely concerned about his well-being. Even though this clinic is not the closest to me, it is well worth the drive for the care of my pet

We're sorry that your experience didn't match your expectations.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, and we'd love the opportunity to make things right. We hope you'll give us another chance to show that we can do better.

Your satisfaction is our priority.

Warm regards,
Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital

Dr. Rose is the best vet I have ever had the pleasure of working with. She saved my dog's life. I was so impressed by the quality of care and followup that she provided. Her patients and their owners are so lucky to have her.

Summer Lawrence, we're sorry to hear that your experience at our business was far less than stellar. We're always working on improving our company's customer service and are committed to providing the best experience to all customers.

We'll be sure to pass your feedback to our staff so they can do their best in the future. Thank you for sharing your opinion about the visit - we appreciate it very much!

With kindest regards
Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital

Sri Redlam, a 1-star experience is not what we want for our customers. We'd love to get a chance to make this right. Would you consider giving us a call so we can discuss how we can address your concerns?

Thank you for your feedback
Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital

My cat, Jack, has been there for boarding. He was very relaxed when I pick him up. He had attention all day, they even put a iPad in his area to watch lizard videos!
These are lovely people!
The vet has answered all my questions and examined Jack. Jack is in good hands!

I cannot recommend Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital and Dr. Jetain Sondhi highly enough! He saved my rescue dog's life, when ALL other veterinarians recommended euthanasia. Thanks to his gentle, thorough, compassionate, competent care, Nala lived to almost 20 years old. His staff is equally wonderful!

I recently brought my 4-month-old puppy to Rancho Bernardo Pet Hospital, and I am beyond thrilled with the experience! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly. It's such a relief to have found a …

Excellent service as always.  The whole staff and doctors are outstanding at this facility.  I trust them 100% in taking care of my GSD!
Thank you.
Amazing customer service. Dr. Sondhi is the best.

All of the doctors and staff here are wonderful. I have a very fearful/reactive dog and the staff always treats him kindly and with care. It is a drive from where I live but so worth it! The prices are also fair and doctors are honest and looking out for the best interest of your pet. I have referred a lot of friends + family here.
Our dog always has a wonderful experience.  Staff and Vet are fantastic!
I love this place very nice excellent service very caring loving towards your pet
R. B. Pet Hospital  is always prompt,  friendly,  and takes  wonderful care of my pup.
